features.description: CaptainAnim pure state machine (interior/captain_anim.gd) driving the billboard with today's stills: 8-sector facing vs the view yaw with hysteresis (se/ne mirrored for sideways until profiles exist), distance-driven phase, start/stop/station/chair/lift/look-up states, reduced motion, procedural bob and lean, foot_down and transition signals; CaptainAvatar reads manifest v2 clips with trim offsets; demo drops the front/back-only facing and the turn to the back (ship_geometry_demo.gd:436); tools/captain_anim_capture.gd; mk/captain-anim.mk
acceptance_criteria: make captain-anim-test (headless): facing sectors in Bow and Astern, hysteresis, distance-driven phase, transitions incl. stand before leaving the chair and look-up on a cue, reduced motion, determinism (AC1)
make captain-anim-test: a scripted starboard walk shows the mirrored three-quarter stand-in with the right flip in >= 95% of frames, never the back (AC2, CA0 half)
make captain-anim-capture (rig): no missing, blank or frozen strip; the sheet opened (AC6)
make test camera-test camera-forward-test deck-layout-eval; make golden ship-demo-bench on the rig (AC7)

AC1, AC2 (CA0 half) met; AC6 machine half met by the review build.
